say:1:1320806001:1.text: Ha! Magister! What brings you here today?
say:1:1320806001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，什么风把你给吹来啦！
say:1:1320806001:1.male: Ha! Magister! What brings you here today?
say:1:1320806001:1.female: Ha! Magister! What brings you here today?

say:2:1320806002:1.text: Don't mind us. What are you doing here, Hugin?
say:2:1320806002:1.source_cn: 呼金，你在这里干什么呢？

say:3:1320806003:1.text: Just checking the craftsmanship of this sculpture. You know that Cedartown's been acting mighty strange lately, right? Some say the festival's over. Others swear it hasn't begun. Everyone is as addled as a rock gnome on a bender.
say:3:1320806003:1.source_cn: 检查工艺。之前雪松镇上有些奇怪的事情，这几天大家都过得...

say:4:1320806004:1.text: This here sculpture is definitely the work of my brethren and I. It couldn't be from any other hands. Yet, if we carved such a splendid creation, how is it we don't remember it?
say:4:1320806004:1.source_cn: 这雕像明明白白是我和同胞的手艺，不可能出自别人之手。但...

say:5:1320806005:1.text: It's just as well you all came. I could do with a mage's keen eye to shed light on the mystery of this carving.
say:5:1320806005:1.source_cn: 正好，你们可以用魔法师的眼光帮我确认确认，这座雕像到底...
say:5:1320806005:1.male: It's just as well you all came. I could do with a mage's keen eye to shed light on the mystery of this carving.
say:5:1320806005:1.female: It's just as well you all came. I could do with a mage's keen eye to shed light on the mystery of this carving.

say:6:1320806006:1.text: What's wrong with it? <style="stress"><player_name></style> even helped to make the Ignis Core.
say:6:1320806006:1.source_cn: 这雕像有什么问题吗？当初还是<style=stress...
say:6:1320806006:1.male: What's wrong with it? <style="stress"><player_name></style> even helped to make the Ignis Core.
say:6:1320806006:1.female: What's wrong with it? <style="stress"><player_name></style> even helped to make the Ignis Core.

say:7:1320806007:1.text: Yeah, but I suspect this sculpture wasn't made according to ofﬁcial procedures!
say:7:1320806007:1.source_cn: 没错，但是我怀疑这雕像并不是按照流程制作的！

say:8:1320806008:1.text: Can the quality be assured when the official steps were skipped? Were the best materials used? Are there any flaws in the sculpture's work? Was it erected according to our specifications? What if it collapses and leads to an accident?
say:8:1320806008:1.source_cn: 没按照流程制作的雕像质量有保证吗？用的是最优质的材料吗...

say:10:1320806010:1.text: Not following official procedures is taboo in engineering. So please use your magic to see if the fire inside shows any signs of leaking or dying.
say:10:1320806010:1.source_cn: 不按流程做事是工程学上的大忌，所以拜托你们用魔法检验一...

say:11:1320806011:1.text: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.
say:11:1320806011:1.source_cn: 其他部分我已经查验过了，而魔法的部分，应该没有任何瑕疵...
say:11:1320806011:1.male: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.
say:11:1320806011:1.female: I've already checked everything except the magic part. But since you're here, nothing should escape <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s eyes when it comes to enchantments.

say:13:1320806012:1.text: Hahaha! This sculpture represents the living will of the people of Cedartown. We're the ones who crafted it, so we've got to shoulder the responsibility.
say:13:1320806012:1.source_cn: 嚯哈哈哈，这是雪松镇民的精神寄托，制作方——也就是我们...

choice:12:0:1.text: Since you say it like that...
choice:12:0:1.male: Since you say it like that...
choice:12:0:1.female: Since you say it like that...

choice:12:1:2.text: It's not necessary, but since you insist.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 毫无必要，不过如果你坚持
choice:12:1:2.male: It's not necessary, but since you insist.
choice:12:1:2.female: It's not necessary, but since you insist.
